{{Recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Italy|Cuisine of Italy]]

==Ingredients==

=== Topping ===
* 300 g [[Cookbook:Prawn|prawn]], fried with 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Oil|vegetable oil]]
* 8 [[Cookbook:Crabstick|crabsticks]], cut into 6 parts and [[Cookbook:Frying|fried]] with 1 tbsp vegetable oil
* 5 fishballs, cut in circles and fried with 1 tbsp vegetable oil
* 3 tbsp [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]

=== Assembly ===

* 3 [[Cookbook:Baguette|baguettes]], cut into 1.5 cm slices

==Procedure==

# In a bowl, combine prawn, crabstick, fishball, parsley, sugar, salt and black pepper. Stir with spoon until well-mixed.
# Top each slice of baguette with some of the the topping mixture.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] the bruschetta at 190°C for 15 minutes.
# Serve hot.
